## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA) Amoghavajra is the *Sanskrit Triskandhaka* — the famous Buddhist confession-repentance text invoking the names of the *thirty-five Buddhas of confession* (三十五佛). The text became one of the most widely chanted Buddhist liturgical texts in East Asia and Tibet, used in monastic confession-rituals throughout the medieval period.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA) Amoghavajra's Cháng'ān period (746 – 774 CE). The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The work is one of the principal texts of the Esoteric-Buddhist devotional tradition that Amoghavajra established at the Tang court.

The Taishō text (T0326) is established on the standard apparatus.
